Senses.Explanation: Through on all sides, open in every reach — the corpus's seven-through-eight-reaching binome for the way with nothing blocking it, from the opened Yunmen gate to the old road that runs straight to Chang'an. Yuanwu Keqin, writing to the layman who shared his shrine-niche: it is the one whose root-stock can leave the rafters of expedient roosting who, with a single raising, knows the landing place — and then molts clear through to the seven-eight estate and shows forth great ease; Zhenjing Kewen, ascending the hall: opening the gate of Yunmen, through seven ways and reaching eight — but you must know there is a latch-pin; if you do not know it, alive you are as dead; the yellow dragon's thousand changes must still be followed into the lair where it hides — fail to arrive, and though you have eyes you are blind; worthies, I watch the way of the sovereign of the teaching: the sovereign of the teaching's way is thus — let the one with eyes discern it. Tianyin Yuanxiu, at the small assembly, raises the old case of Nanyuan asking Fengxue how the southern staff is weighed, Fengxue's quaint weighing back, and the staff beneath which no birth-and-death remains — Fengxue's awakening was not nothing, but it fell into the second head; were I Nanyuan, says the master, the moment he opened his mouth to ask how the staff is weighed here, a staff across his spine would guarantee him through seven ways and reaching eight — though today's crude fellows take it as one staff, burying the old sages and blinding not a few eyes; Yinyuan Longqi, holding up the fly-whisk: before the staff-tip has even touched, the whole realm is fully manifest; the nose hangs down, the whole body exposed; take it on entire and you leap past buddhas and patriarchs at a stroke — and if you cannot yet, here I draw one thread of a road for you: shining on heaven and mirroring earth, this shore and that shore through seven ways and reaching eight, and then the great tongs can work, the great function apply — smashing the crowns of buddhas and patriarchs, overturning the patch-robed one's very handle. Sanyi Mingyu, raising the whisk: Wanshou's one old road — through seven ways, reaching eight, straight through to Chang'an; come by boat or come by land, nothing is not possible — only Qianfeng was too spare for you and Yunmen too lavish; I bustle before and behind, lifting and carrying, merely to get you home and able to rest, in the colored robes facing your parents in the front hall, meeting your brothers again under the red-bud tree; Lianyue Daozheng, entering the temple: the gate-court lonely and steep, the inner hall deep — tell me, from where does one enter? — three strikes of the staff: opened through, seven ways and eight, done! And in he goes; Fangrong Ruxi, asked what is the exceeding through the one gate: the seven-through-eight-reaching one does not go — yet you lean on exceeding through a single gate. And the limit, at the hanging of the bell-board: Yinxin Foming Jina lifts the striker — just this use, off this use: the mirror of buddhas and patriarchs, the command of humans and gods — it makes even the seven-through-eight-reaching one, on arrival, hardly escape fumbling hands and flurried feet; grant him three heads and six arms, still he must hear the command and surrender. And what is the proof? He strikes the bell-board: beware hearing it.
